_about: Training recipe of the light RAFT round (both experts, 300 steps each, from the GT-SFT generator at step 4000). launch/raft.sh resolves the placeholders, drops the keys starting with '_' and writes the result to <work>/train/OVERRIDES.json, which scripts/train_s2_v4.py reads.
_placeholders: {repo_root} = the repository root; {sft_data} = $MOPLAN_SFT_DATA (GT-SFT payloads under pools/{p101,ssv2,phyco}/); {raft_data} = $MOPLAN_RAFT_DATA (the RAFT condition caches cache_{phyco,phycoB,p101,p101B}/); {sft_checkpoint} = $MOPLAN_SFT_CHECKPOINT (high/ and low/ of the GT-SFT generator); {winners} = the folder with every selected candidate <sample_id>.pt; {expert} = high or low, substituted by the trainer.
_replay: The seven GT-SFT pools and their mix are the replay data (the mix of the GT-SFT run). The raft_* pools are not in the mix: they only hold the conditions the candidates were sampled under, and each selected candidate is trained under the condition of its own pool. dpo_prob is the share of micro-steps that train on a selected candidate; dpo_negative_weight 0 with dpo_sft_weight 1 means plain flow matching on the candidate (no preference term, no reference model).
